description: INSPIRE-harmonized land use dataset for the Netherlands, based on the Dutch topographic map (BRT) and aerial photography from summer 2015. This is the European INSPIRE version of the CBS Bestand Bodemgebruik (BBG), transformed to conform to the INSPIRE Existing Land Use data specification. Each polygon is classified using the HILUCS (Hierarchical INSPIRE Land Use Classification System) instead of the Dutch national classification. Native CRS is EPSG:3035 (ETRS89-LAEA), the European standard coordinate reference system. Published by CBS (Centraal Bureau voor de Statistiek / Statistics Netherlands) via PDOK.

table:columns.name: gml_id
table:columns.description: Technical XML id of the feature in the source INSPIRE GML (gml:id); unique within the delivered file.

table:columns.name: description
table:columns.description: Generic gml:description text carried from the source GML feature; not an attribute of the INSPIRE LU schema.

table:columns.name: name
table:columns.description: Generic gml:name text carried from the source GML feature; not an attribute of the INSPIRE LU schema.

table:columns.name: localId
table:columns.description: Local identifier assigned by the data provider; unique within the namespace (INSPIRE Identifier.localId, GCM).

table:columns.name: namespace
table:columns.description: Namespace uniquely identifying the data source of the spatial object (INSPIRE Identifier.namespace, GCM).

table:columns.name: beginLifespanVersion
table:columns.description: Date and time at which this version of the spatial object was inserted or changed in the spatial data set (LU/GCM lifecycle attribute).

table:columns.name: hilucsPresence
table:columns.description: Actual presence of HILUCS (Hierarchical INSPIRE Land Use Classification System) categories in the object, as percentages or an importance-ordered list.

table:columns.name: specificPresence
table:columns.description: Actual presence of land use categories of the provider-specific classification within the object, as percentages or ordered list (LU specificPresence).

table:columns.name: observationDate
table:columns.description: The observation date associated to the land use description, e.g. date of the survey or imagery it is based on (ExistingLandUseObject.observationDate).

table:columns.name: validFrom
table:columns.description: The time when the phenomenon started to exist in the real world (LU validFrom; real-world validity, not dataset lifecycle).

table:columns.name: validTo
table:columns.description: The time from which the phenomenon no longer exists in the real world (LU validTo).

table:columns.name: geometry
table:columns.description: Feature geometry, WKB encoded; see proj:epsg for the CRS.

table:columns.name: geometry_bbox
table:columns.type: struct<xmin: float, ymin: float, xmax: float, ymax: float>
table:columns.description: Technical: per-feature bounding box struct added for spatial filtering (GeoParquet covering).
